scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && esbuild server/app/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=dist-server/main.js && cp server/ingestion/pdf-worker.mjs dist-server/pdf-worker.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src server shared scripts tests e2e docs *.md *.json *.ts *.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src server shared scripts tests e2e docs *.md *.json *.ts *.html
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm test && playwright test
scripts.test:stress: vite build --config vite.stress.config.ts && playwright test --config playwright.stress.config.ts
scripts.test:stress:trace: vite build --config vite.stress.config.ts && STRESS_TRACE=1 playwright test --config playwright.stress.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.preview:stress: vite build --config vite.stress.config.ts && vite preview --config vite.stress.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4180 --strictPort
scripts.preview:stress:device: vite build --config vite.stress.config.ts && node --import tsx scripts/preview-device.ts
